_comment: Versioned scheme rules. Every rule carries a stable ID, the layer it belongs to, an effective date, the source it derives from, and both a passing and a failing fixture. A rule without all six must not be published — scripts/generate-manifest-facts.mjs enforces this.
id_policy: Rule IDs are stable across minor releases. A change in pass/fail behaviour requires a new ruleset version and a change-log entry, never a silent edit.

rules.title: Fully unstructured postal address is not accepted
rules.summary: From 14 November 2026 a fully unstructured postal address is rejected in CBPR+ payment messages.
rules.remediation: Supply Town Name and Country in their structured elements. A compliant hybrid address is sufficient; a fully structured address is preferred.

rules.title: Town Name is mandatory in a structured element
rules.summary: Town Name must be carried in TwnNm, not in an address line.
rules.remediation: Move the town into <TwnNm>. Leaving it inside <AdrLine> does not satisfy the requirement.

rules.title: Country is mandatory as a two-letter ISO 3166 code
rules.applies_when: Ctry is absent, empty, or not a 2-character code
rules.summary: Country must be carried in Ctry as a two-letter ISO 3166 alpha-2 code.
rules.remediation: Use the alpha-2 code, for example GB rather than United Kingdom or GBR.

rules.title: Hybrid postal address is accepted
rules.applies_when: TwnNm and Ctry are structured and AdrLine is also present
rules.summary: A hybrid address — structured Town Name and Country alongside address lines — is accepted, both before and after the November 2026 change.
rules.remediation: No action required. Note that a fully structured address remains preferable for downstream data quality.

rules.title: Agent identified by BIC only is exempt
rules.applies_when: party is an agent identified solely by BIC with no postal address
rules.summary: For agent fields, BIC-only identification remains valid; no postal address is required.
rules.remediation: No action required. Do not add a partial address purely to satisfy the address rule.

rules.title: Message types excepted from the address requirement
rules.applies_when: message type is one of the excepted identifiers
rules.summary: The structured address requirement does not apply to admi.024, camt.025, camt.052, camt.053, camt.054 and camt.060.
rules.remediation: No action required for these message types.

rules.title: CHAPS validation library rejects fully unstructured addresses
rules.summary: From November 2026 the CHAPS validation library rejects payments carrying a fully unstructured address. Hybrid is the minimum acceptable form.
rules.remediation: Structure the address to at least hybrid form before submission to CHAPS.

rules.title: Purpose codes become mandatory on all CHAPS payments
rules.summary: From November 2027 the Bank of England requires a purpose code on all CHAPS payments, extending the earlier property and FI-to-FI requirement.
rules.remediation: Populate <Purp><Cd> with an appropriate ISO 20022 external purpose code.
rules.note: Effective date is the announced month; the exact day should be re-verified against the Bank of England policy statement before this rule is enforced.

rules.title: Structured remittance information becomes mandatory for CHAPS
rules.applies_when: RmtInf/Strd is absent where remittance information is supplied
rules.summary: From November 2027 remittance information carried in CHAPS payments must be structured.
rules.remediation: Carry remittance data in <RmtInf><Strd> rather than <RmtInf><Ustrd>.
rules.note: Announced in the Bank of England consultation; re-verify scope and exact date before enforcement.
